Southeast Asia vehicle quote audit

FOB vs CIF vehicle quotes for Southeast Asia: include permits and island delivery

For Southeast Asian shipments, compare FOB and CIF to a named port, then check feeder services, inter-island carriage and registration separately. Price the route to the actual delivery island, not just the main port.

Replace Southeast Asia with a country, port, island and city

State the destination country, discharge terminal, importer, final city or island, expected declaration date, registration market and physical handover. If the main vessel reaches a regional hub before a feeder, barge, ferry or road leg, identify the transshipment port, carriers, custody points, connection windows and party responsible for import clearance or bonded movement on each segment.

Freeze model year, exact variant, steering side, powertrain, condition, quantity and VINs. ASEAN's light-EV guidelines map differences among member states, so “Southeast Asia specification” is not an approval. New or used eligibility, left- or right-hand drive, import licence, whole-vehicle approval, charging interface, battery evidence and registration must be confirmed by the final country.

Place FOB or CIF at the real maritime handover

FOB should name the Chinese shipment port and list factory collection, inland haulage, inspection, export declaration, terminal and loading; risk normally transfers on board the buyer-nominated vessel. CIF names a destination port and requires the seller to pay main sea carriage and arrange insurance, but risk still transfers on board in China rather than when the vehicle reaches Southeast Asia.

A container is commonly delivered to a terminal or carrier before ship loading, so assess FCA. If the seller is responsible for insured multimodal carriage that includes feeder or inland movement, assess CIP. The appendix should state container or RoRo, direct or transshipped service, carrier, booking deadline, free time, EV battery state and any acceptance condition for used vehicles.

Keep separate ledgers for the main voyage and last mile

Ledger one covers vehicle, China documents, inland movement and origin terminal; two covers main sea freight, surcharges, transshipment and insurance; three covers discharge, documentation, terminal, inspection, storage and destination agency; four separately covers feeder vessel, ferry, inter-island dangerous-goods arrangements, road or rail, bonded transit and final delivery; five covers permits, taxes, approval, modification and registration.

Each line needs currency, billing unit, tax, payer, payee, validity and written basis. Obtain one schedule at the discharge port and another for the final city so the main-port agent does not stop at the terminal while the local carrier starts only outside the gate. Define an approval process for storage or rebooking costs caused by a cancelled feeder, missed connection or port delay.

Use Singapore to see why FOB price is not customs value

Singapore Customs' current valuation pages explain treatment when actual freight or insurance is unavailable for FOB imports, and its motor-vehicle example adds freight, handling and insurance to an FOB vehicle price to establish customs value. The example clearly shows that buying FOB does not automatically make the bare vehicle price taxable and that quantifiable transport and insurance evidence matters.

Singapore's method does not govern Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam, the Philippines or another destination. The importer should recalculate under national classification, condition, origin, party relationship, freight, insurance, exchange rate and declaration date. Separate a CIF amount into its components too, so post-import inland costs are not included or added twice.

Secure the permit and technical route before locking freight

Malaysia MITI's personal-vehicle Approved Permit and Singapore's vehicle import and registration procedures show that permission, valuation, clearance and registration are national stages independent of the Incoterm. Before payment, the importer should test the proposed VIN or exact specification against applicant eligibility, timing, any category or quota, required tests, document language, validity and pre-shipment conditions.

For an EV, verify destination charging requirements, approval of any supplied charging equipment, software and service support. For an island or ferry leg, obtain the actual carrier's written acceptance of the battery vehicle, required state of charge, declaration and securing. Allocate the consequences of a refused permit or carriage booking in the deposit refund and replacement-shipment clauses.

Compare at registration point and stress-test connections

Price FOB and CIF to the same city or island, adding destination port, taxes, valuation exposure, permit, feeder, inland movement, approval, registration, foreign exchange and delay. Mark unknowns open with an owner and deadline. Test three scenarios separately: a main-vessel delay misses the feeder, late documents create storage, and cargo cover ends at the discharge port.

A buyer with local networks, feeder contracts and door-to-door insurance may gain control under FOB or FCA. A seller with transparent main carriage, usable insurance and a reliable destination partner may make CIF or CIP smoother. Either way, steering configuration, import permission, technical acceptance, charging compliance and road registration require separate written acceptance from the responsible national parties.

Frequently asked questions

Does CIF to Singapore or a regional hub include island delivery?

Do not assume it does. CIF reaches the named port; feeder, ferry, inland and final delivery require separate cost and insurance confirmation.

Is the FOB vehicle price the Southeast Asian customs value?

Not necessarily. The destination may add freight, insurance and other adjustments under its national valuation rules.

Does ASEAN issue one vehicle import permit?

No. Eligibility, steering side, technical standards, taxes and registration remain national matters.

Does a Malaysian Approved Permit work elsewhere in ASEAN?

No. It is a Malaysian national process and does not replace another country's import permission.

What additional checks apply to an EV quote?

Confirm carrier acceptance, battery state and declaration, destination charging and technical approval, feeder or ferry rules and service support.
